name: git-cure
description: Terminal-native Git diagnostics and recovery tool powered by Gemma

scripts.dev:all: npm run dev --workspace=@git-cure/server & npm run dev --workspace=@git-cure/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@git-cure/dashboard && npm run typecheck --workspace=@git-cure/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@git-cure/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=@git-cure/gemma
